data.title: National Park Service finds no significant environmental impact for North Entrance Road reconstruction project in Yellowstone National Park
data.abstract: The National Park Service (NPS) signed a Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI) and associated Wetlands/Floodplains Statement of Findings (SOF) to reconstruct the North Entrance Road between Mammoth Hot Springs, Wyoming, and Gardiner, Montana, in Yellowstone National Park.
